items.title: Implement a centralized Engineering Knowledge Platform within SWARM Automation.
items.summary:
The goal is not simply to add vector/RAG search. The goal is to create persistent, structured, source-backed engineering memory across everything a user has connected to SWARM.

Over time, SWARM should understand:

* what the user's software systems contain
* how repositories relate to each other
* why engineering decisions were made
* what issues and PRs changed
* what AI agents attempted
* what adversarial agents found
* what succeeded and failed
* what models/reasoning levels were used
* how
